content:
Leah: quick flag  canary shows a small but steady bump in projectless routing for org 'acme-corp' (0.9% -> 1.8%)
Ben: hm, alert threshold is 1%. Any idea where it's coming from?
Ibrahim: sampling shows API-key auth where introspector returns project_id:null despite X-Project header present
Sofia: that sounds like the header->claim shim running after routing cache lookup
Leah: yep, we recently moved header normalization into shared middleware to dedupe logic
Ben: tradeoff was cache cardinality vs correctness. Did we add an allowlist guard?
Ibrahim: not yet; the shared shim was optimistic and maps all X-Project-* headers into claims
Sofia: proposed fix: for canary revert ordering so shim runs before rate-limit lookup and add allowlist to limit new cache keys
Leah: agree. plan: 10% canary reorder + shim.allowlist_projects config, monitor projectless_route_pct per-org for 20m
deploy-bot: PR created -> staging-canary (10%): https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/5999 CI: green
Ben: add a dashboard tile and alert annotation with a trace link
Sofia: will do, also add a unit test asserting header->claim mapping for api-keys
Leah: rolling forward with canary now, watching telemetry
